last_action: REPLAN + PHASE 0 RESTRUCTURE, both shipped. The project had reported 'blocked' since 2026-05-25 on two [!] markers git had already resolved (4bdb8f4; c6b9419 via Stack.Protected), while ~20 commits of June work went unrecorded. Wrote juniper-design/DECISIONS.md (D1-D9) — the mechanism Alchemilla had and Juniper didn't — and rewrote PLAN.md, TASKS.md and STATUS.md against it. Then shipped the restructure in three commits: 570d211 collapsed three repos into one at the wrapper folder with juniper-app's history preserved (87 renames), bringing juniper-design/ and status/ under version control and folding in the June working-tree edits; bf0f3ff replaced the Next.js tracker with a four-file static site deployed from the root via vercel.json; 2e230f0 finished the Jungle Jungle rename to com.wheredidfranciscogo.juniper ahead of the first EAS build and dropped the web target. Two things surfaced that the docs had been wrong about for months: the splash screen was still rendering 'Jungle Jungle', and .github/ sat inside juniper-app/ where GitHub never reads it — so CI had been dead since the collapse and is now fixed with working-directory: juniper-app. Verified green throughout: tsc clean, 12 suites / 105 tests, expo export --platform ios at 4.16 MB.

Keep nextWateringDate() RN-free so it is node-testable. Remaining human items: push the new repo to github.com/wheredidfranciscogo/juniper and archive the old juniper-app repo; point Vercel at the new repo.
